definitions.explanation: Walking at a fast pace, often suggesting urgency or purpose. Commonly used with に as an adverbial modifier.

examples.japanese: {足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk at a brisk pace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち{去|さ}った→立ち去る：04640_tachisaru⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: Since it started raining, I hurried toward the station.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the adverbial form {足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Describes purposeful, brisk walking rather than running.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk briskly)
- {足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{去|さ}る→立ち去る：04640_tachisaru⟧ (to hurry away)
- {足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧ (to pass by quickly)
- {足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (to head somewhere hurriedly)

The expression {足早|あしばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ often implies the person is in a hurry or wants to leave a situation quickly.
